name: The Gatehouse
about: The first floor inside the tower. Level 1 is the Waiting Hall (the lobby) just inside the gate; level 10 is Marta, the Gatekeeper, at the stair. Red marks the Gatekeeper's own.

lines: Once you begin the climb, there is no way back. You can only go up, or die.
You may stop on any floor, at any time, but that floor becomes your home until you die.
Or you can press on, and reach the top, or die trying.
intro.tone: Ominous. Deliberately bleak: stopping is a one-way choice, not a rest stop.
